facts.fact: 她靠在他肩上闭眼走——每一步都是完全的信任。
他的发现：柔情比暴力更让她害怕。
facts.anchor: Apparently, tenderness frightened my wife more than violence.

facts.fact: 他等她的判决：战、逃、还是留。
facts.anchor: I waited for her to give me the verdict.

facts.fact: 他的自省：我一辈子为所爱的人打碎东西。
facts.anchor: I'd spent my whole life breaking things for the people I loved.

facts.fact: 他的目标：为她学会「不弄坏地抱住」。
facts.anchor: For Rosalind, I'd learn how to hold on without breaking her.

facts.fact: 他的新协议：从现在起先告诉我。
facts.anchor: From now on, tell me first.

facts.fact: 他的宣告：你永远、永远甩不掉我。
facts.anchor: You are never, ever getting rid of me.

facts.fact: 为 Rosalind，他要学会不弄坏她就抱住她。
facts.anchor: For Rosalind, I'd learn how to hold on without breaking her.

facts.fact: 章末：随便打，我不会放手，我会永远追来，你是我的。
facts.anchor: "Fight me as hard as you want. I will never let you go. I will always come for you. You are mine."
